title: Distinguish synthetic security-test sentinels from secrets
description: The live reconciled preflight flagged six deliberate credential-rejection fixtures in tracked test sources; the exact package archive had zero matches. The generic scanner must stop false positives without weakening package/dist scanning or allowing real source secrets.
design: Keep package and dist byte scanning strict. In tracked source only, reject real secret-like material but recognize narrowly provable test sentinels and code-call false positives using path-aware, deterministic rules. Never print matched values.
acceptance_criteria: All six known synthetic source fixtures pass; a real random credential in any source including test paths still fails; candidate package remains exact and clean; full tests, validator, secret scan, independent security review, Green PR, exact installed-byte verification.
notes: Final independent security review found no P0/P1. Exact path plus full raw-line commitments close prefix/suffix smuggling; strict surfaces reject on the first yielded finding to avoid memory exhaustion. Complete mapping equality prevents alias-path expansion. Focused 53/53, full deployment suite 137/137, full repo validation, exact candidate source/package audit, secret scan, and diff check pass.
close_reason: False-positive compatibility is exact-bound, adversarially tested, independently reviewed, and preserves strict deployable-byte audits.

title: Fix coded app deploy package/display-name binding
description: UiPath CLI 1.198.0 uses codedapp deploy --name for both published package lookup and visible title. uipcodedappdeploy v2.2 passes app_name, so package_name != app_name publishes successfully but deploy cannot find the package. Add a governed plan-bound app config stage so deployment looks up the exact package while preserving the requested display title, and certify recovery without live writes.
design: Use the CLI-supported .uipath/app.config.json contract with appName=package_name and displayName=app_name. Add a deterministic local stage before deploy and include the config digest in plan/receipt binding. Never mutate an existing registered systemName or app URL field during planning.
acceptance_criteria: Plans bind exact package and display names; execution writes only the expected ignored app config before deploy; deploy omits the ambiguous --name flag; schema/tests/docs are versioned; full skill tests pass; installed skill is synced only from merged reviewed source.
notes: AgenticGTM alpha mockup package aura-vdp-template-mockup 0.1.0 published; app creation did not occur. Root cause: CLI 1.198.0 uses --name as both package lookup and visible title. Read-only subagent review required and then confirmed: validate the fresh regular CLI app config; reject unknown, stale, symlinked, or mismatched metadata; atomically bind only displayName; record and revalidate the exact digest; omit --name only for distinct display titles. Contract v2.3 implements this and rejects v2.2 recovery. Independent final verdict: no blocker. title: Fix uipcodedappdeploy v2.1 self-invalidating version stage
description: Execution currently mutates tracked pyproject.toml before _validate_source(), so every approved plan whose planned version differs from source fails its own clean-source gate. Reorder or narrowly validate the exact planned version mutation without weakening source/digest binding.
acceptance_criteria: Regression test exercises the real execute ordering without mocking _validate_source; unrelated tracked or untracked source drift still fails; exact planned pyproject version succeeds; plan and receipt hashes remain bound; full uipcodedappdeploy test/validation suite passes; installed skill parity is restored.
notes:
Implemented fail-closed source validation and remediated both independent-review blockers. Execution now checks exact HEAD, exact index-to-HEAD parity, and rejects assume-unchanged, skip-worktree, sparse, unmerged, or other hidden index state. It independently verifies every HEAD-tracked path type, Git executable mode, and content using HEAD attributes; recursively verifies submodules; and forces status inspection with ignore-submodules=none plus NUL-delimited porcelain parsing. Version-stage allowances are plan/stage-bound: pyproject.toml and, when uv.lock exists, a deterministic local-project-version-only uv.lock transition are separately hashed in initial/versioned input snapshots. Resume recognizes the plan-derived post-version/pre-lock state without allowing unrelated drift. Real temporary-Git regressions do not mock _validate_source and cover explicit version success, tracked build drift, newline untracked paths, assume-unchanged, skip-worktree, submodule ignore=all, arbitrary rehashed lock transition rejection, actual uv lock success, and lock-stage resume. Installed-skill parity remains intentionally pending per release-owner instruction, so this issue stays in progress.

Added a real .gitattributes filter=mask regression with git-add/index parity and empty status that fails before version write, plus an unchanged filtered/smudged worktree success case. v2.1 plans/receipts are explicitly rejected and must be regenerated without migration. Verification: focused uipcodedappdeploy 61/61 Green; full uv-isolated make validate Green (12 skills/275 text files, all Python suites, Node 470/470, diff-check); secret scan Green. title: Publish Beads lifecycle history for collaborators
description:
## Problem
The repository currently commits only the latest .beads/issues.jsonl snapshot. Full lifecycle history remains in the local embedded Dolt database and is not transparent to GitHub collaborators.

## Required change
Add a supported, deterministic, Git-tracked audit-history artifact and collaborator workflow that preserves issue state transitions without committing machine-local Dolt internals.

## Verification
Prove a fresh clone can inspect the current issues and their published lifecycle history; validate generated artifacts for secrets, local paths, deterministic ordering, and repository compatibility.
acceptance_criteria: GitHub contains current Beads state plus reviewable lifecycle history; generation is reproducible and validated; collaborator instructions explain refresh and recovery; a fresh-clone verification passes; PR checks pass.
notes:
Subagent research and audit findings:
- Beads 1.0.3 supports full-history publication to the same GitHub repository through refs/dolt/data. Fresh clones discover that ref with bd bootstrap --yes before falling back to issues.jsonl. The supported push path is an explicit Dolt remote and bd dolt push; force pushes must be prohibited.
- Fresh-clone audit proved issues.jsonl alone restores current fields, labels, notes, and dependencies but collapses skills-ra5 from 17 native history rows to one imported snapshot and skills-nnz from 12 rows to one. Plain bd init is destructive here: it created an empty DB and deleted the tracked snapshot. Safe setup is chmod 700 .beads, bd bootstrap --yes, git config beads.role maintainer, and bd hooks install --beads.
- bd history is only an issue-table projection: it repeats unchanged rows and omits label, dependency, comment, external-ref, and started-at history. interactions.jsonl and the unimplemented bd export --events path are not valid substitutes. Therefore the design must pair the native Dolt ref with an explicitly limited, deduplicated Git-review projection.
- Transparency and privacy review found zero known secret or local-path pattern matches in the current native issue, event, dependency, comment, and Dolt-log data. Native data intentionally includes Keith Born and keith.born@uipath.com; Dolt root attribution is not useful and is excluded from the projection. All Beads values must be treated as public.
- Hardening recommendation adopted: deterministic history.jsonl, a manifest anchoring artifact hashes to Dolt HEAD, offline terminal-state and append-only validation, recursive decoded-JSON leak scanning, safe bootstrap docs, and fresh-clone recovery proof.
Integration and verification evidence:
- Published native Dolt history to GitHub refs/dolt/data without force and verified the ref from both HTTPS and SSH Git remotes.
- Published 17 deduplicated issue-state transitions plus a SHA-256 manifest anchored to Dolt HEAD clvcd0hueuc5de6v97c2mi75hjm70hvv.
- Scanned 683 historical rows across issues, events, dependencies, comments, labels, config, metadata, interactions, and Dolt log records; found zero known secret or local-path pattern matches.
- Repeated export under TZ=UTC and LC_ALL=C produced identical issues, history, and manifest hashes.
- Full local validation passed: 11 skills, all Python suites, 162 Node tests, whitespace checks, and secret scan across 212 Git-visible text files.
- Cold clone bootstrap dry-run selected sync.remote and cloned from the GitHub Dolt ref, not issues.jsonl. The recovered native head matched the manifest; bd history returned 18 rows for skills-ra5, 13 for skills-nnz, and 3 for skills-ts6; both dependency links, notes, and labels survived.
- Fresh-clone current-state export was byte-identical, hooks installed successfully, metadata and secret validation passed, and Git remained clean.
- Draft PR 4 commit d6b9de6 passed both push and pull-request GitHub Validate runs.
close_reason: Native Beads history, review projection, manifest, safe collaborator workflow, fresh-clone recovery, and GitHub checks are verified.

## Verification

Fix: enumerate Git tracked plus untracked non-ignored files when the validation root is a Git worktree, with the existing recursive fallback for non-Git test fixtures. Added a regression test proving ignored .beads/embeddeddolt state is excluded while non-ignored .beads/config.yaml remains validated. Verified with make validate and make secrets using isolated Python 3.12 plus pinned requirements: 11 skills validated, all Python suites passed, 162 Node tests passed, diff checks passed, and the secret scan passed for 208 candidate files.

title: Initialize Beads for development history

## Context
This repository needs durable, dependency-aware progress and historical tracking for development and build work.

## Work
Initialize Beads with a repository-local Dolt database, tracked JSONL export, Git hooks, and agent workflow instructions.

## Verification
Confirm the database opens, hooks are installed, issue history is queryable, and the ready queue works.
acceptance_criteria: Embedded Dolt opens and reports the skills database; the skills- prefix is active; repository hooks are executable; issue lifecycle history is queryable; Codex integration is current; embedded-versus-shared persistence is documented; ready/list commands work; and .beads/issues.jsonl exports durable shared tracker state.
notes:

title: Add lossless schema 1.6 export adapter for Day 2 enricher
description: Current app imports canonical schema 1.4 and exports schema 1.6 with stable row IDs, consumption ARR, evidenceLedger, and fieldEvidenceLinks. The skill correctly rejects 1.6, so browser Export JSON cannot currently be reused as its input.
design: Implement an explicit read-only 1.6-to-1.4 projection only when lossless: structured evidence/link arrays empty, every consumption ARR blank, IDs valid and globally unique, and no unknown keys. Write a new private 1.4 artifact plus digest-bound conversion receipt; reject any lossy case. A native 1.6 upgrade is a separate larger decision.
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic tests accept only lossless normalized 1.6 exports; reject nonblank ARR, structured evidence/links, invalid or duplicate IDs, unknown keys, and overwrite attempts; original remains unchanged; output strict-validates as 1.4; docs and current app harness agree.
notes: Discovered during maximum-coverage audit. Current change fixes the stale import harness and documents the limitation but does not silently strip 1.6 data.
